lang_code.description: The language code to match for applying this font configuration (e.g., 'gu' for Gujarati).

target_family.description: The generic font family name to match against (e.g., 'sans-serif').

font_family_name.description: The specific font family name to prepend and alias.

hinting_enabled.description: Whether to enable font hinting (true) or disable it (false).
